development_repairs.cause: Test-only helper passed NULL slope to scm_ocv_eval, whose documented implementation requires both output pointers. Invalid independent observations cascaded through Joseph and score expectations.
development_repairs.repair: Pass a valid local slope output. No production source or numerical tolerance changed.

common_score_review.problem: Adding a huge finite common log score before normalization erases carried log odds or causes avoidable overflow.
common_score_review.repair: Core now subtracts max(score) before adding prior log weights and preserves exactly equal scores byte-exact. This is algebra-equivalent stabilization, not a likelihood floor or tuning.
common_score_review.test_change: Added two common-score identity fixtures; prior overflow fixture now uses different predictive variances so relative-score plus prior odds genuinely overflows.

underflow_moment_review.problem: Computing sqrt(exp(log_weight)) and skipping a component when exp(log_weight)==0 can erase a representable weighted covariance contribution.
underflow_moment_review.required_fix: Derive square-root weights directly from log weights and use their representability for moment terms; linear mean weights and retained components/hulls remain unchanged.
underflow_moment_review.fix: Core computes normalized log-root weights directly, includes covariance/between terms even if linear weight underflows, and uses log-magnitude evaluation when the root weight itself is subnormal/zero. No new persistent/workspace storage.
underflow_moment_review.fixture_tolerance: 2e-13 relative for independent log/multiply evaluation order; checks target representable weighted SD, not underflowed linear weight.

decision: The tested core implements the frozen two-component numerical/transaction contract after two algebraic robustness corrections. No current blocking defect found in this scope.

independent_review.full_covariance: Packed lower factor retains all136 joint entries. Physical transition matches the independent model and finite-difference transport; scalar correction matches a separately formed dense Joseph matrix using the same actual feasible gains. Rank deficiency/zero pivot/zero residual and constrained updates pass.
independent_review.transaction: Live bank remains immutable through candidate corrections and normalization. Any component correction or relative-weight failure discards both trials and regenerates predictions from old numeric state. Prediction failure consumes known input once and withholds current points. All-zero regeneration restores both mean and factor first.
independent_review.evidence: Conditional evidence cursors can differ, while physical chronology and bank event counts agree. Weight-only updates advance bank evidence only when a relative score produces a represented weight change; missing/rejected/all-zero unchanged observations do not manufacture freshness. Equal likelihood evidence preserves prior odds exactly.
independent_review.queries: Mixture SD includes within and between components without collapsing inference state. Log-magnitude scaling retains representable weighted covariance even when linear and square-root weights underflow. All-component local hulls use both factors regardless of conditional availability or display weight. Geometric capacity point is not a physical posterior mean or coverage quantile.
independent_review.public_initialization: One public logQ moment split preserves original full log-state mean/covariance within roundoff, without truth-derived placement. Its Gaussian-mixture density differs from the original Gaussian.
independent_review.resources: Actual sizeof bank2976+workspace3504+query592+config56+input24=7152B. Source review found no heap allocation, hidden dense matrix, extra full predicted state or raw history in the core. Complete target costs and software math remain separately unmeasured.
independent_review.failure_capture: Rejection stage and component identify whole-bank numerical rejection. The original historical17 rejects remain unattributed by these constructed fixtures.
independent_review.work_bound: Initial2 predictions +up to2 all-zero reconstructions +up to2 rejection reconstructions; at most2 corrections and2 scores. No loop to convergence.

remaining_limits: These finite numerical fixtures do not demonstrate capacity or SOC accuracy on the cell stream.
No validated uncertainty coverage, hard full-model support, global physical-history consistency or indefinite-time learning guarantee.
Large finite cumulative log odds can still lose small relative increments or overflow under genuine differential evidence; explicit failure semantics are tested, not an all-prefix proof.
Cortex-M23 full SRAM, stack/software math, deadline and interrupt behavior remain unqualified.
Checkpoint implementation is reviewed and tested separately by the IO agent.
